findings.title: `enableSqlExpressions` reads the feature flag, then ignores it, and its variable name says the opposite of what it holds.
findings.body: The local variable `enabled` holds `!IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions)`, so it is true when the flag is *off*. Both branches then return `false`, so the flag check does nothing. The function and its variable suggest that turning on `sqlExpressions` would enable the feature. That is not true. Someone who later "fixes" the dead branch by returning `enabled` would turn SQL expressions back on exactly when the flag is off, and that is the RCE path this PR closes. Make it return `false` directly, with a comment saying SQL expressions are disabled whatever the flag says.
